full_prompt_en: A square studio photograph presents a single full-length costumed figure standing frontally against a seamless pale gray background. The figure is centered with legs apart and arms relaxed slightly away from the body. A large helmet or mask conceals the entire face. The dark front contains several circular lens-like openings and protruding round parts, while thin rods, spikes, and blade-shaped fragments project from the top and sides of the head. Layers of jackets, straps, panels, and hanging objects cover the torso. White sleeves are interrupted by bright yellow, hot pink, orange, blue, and black patches; a crowded set of small rectangular and cylindrical pieces sits across the chest. The lower half consists of loose dark trousers or layered fabric panels, coated with splashes and frayed edges. A large angular piece hangs along the right side, and both shoes have multiple color accents, one more reddish and the other more yellow. No bare skin is visible. The surface appears assembled from painted plastic or metal fragments, textiles, tapes, and cables, with scratches and uneven edges kept visible. The pale floor under the shoes has a faint diffuse shadow. Even studio lighting from above and slightly left reveals the many raised pieces without dramatic background shadows. The silhouette is roughly human but enlarged and irregular because of its projecting components. The sparse gray setting isolates the complex wearable structure, so the eye can travel from spiky headgear through layered chest objects to the mismatched shoes.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形影棚照片在无接缝浅灰背景前呈现一名正面站立、全身可见的装扮人物。人物居中，双腿分开，双臂略离开身体自然下垂。硕大的头盔或面罩遮住整张脸。深色正面有多个圆形镜片状开口和外凸圆件，细杆、尖刺与刀片状碎片从头顶和两侧伸出。层层夹克、带子、板片和悬挂物覆盖上身。白色衣袖被亮黄、热粉、橘、蓝和黑色斑块切开；胸前挤着许多小矩形与圆柱形部件。下半身是宽松深色裤装或叠层布片，带有泼溅颜料和磨毛边缘。右侧垂下一块较大的棱角物，两只鞋有多种颜色重点，一只更偏红，另一只更偏黄。看不到裸露皮肤。表面像由上色塑料或金属碎片、布料、胶带和线缆组合而成，刮痕与不齐边缘保留可见。鞋下浅地面有淡淡散射阴影。从上方略偏左来的均匀影棚光显出众多凸起部件，却不在背景造成戏剧性暗影。轮廓大致是人形，但伸出的组件让它变大且不规则。稀疏灰色环境隔出复杂可穿戴结构，让视线从刺状头饰经过层叠胸前物件走向不相同的两只鞋。
style_prompt_en: Studio photography isolates a densely assembled irregular silhouette against an almost empty neutral field. Build the visual surface from layered painted fragments, frayed textiles, straps, protrusions, and small mismatched components, leaving scratches and construction seams visible. Use black and dirty white as a base, then place vivid hot pink, yellow, orange, cyan, and red accents in uneven scattered bursts. Even high studio light reveals each raised piece and casts only a mild grounding shadow. Keep the outline legible from a distance despite the dense internal noise; long spikes or rods can punctuate the upper edge while heavier pieces anchor below. The transferable effect is confrontational and inventive, driven by found-material texture, maximal layering, asymmetrical detail, and a clean presentation ground.
style_prompt_zh: 影棚摄影把密集组装的不规则剪影从几乎空白的中性背景中隔出。视觉表面由层叠上色碎片、磨毛布料、带子、外凸物和不相同的小组件构成，刮痕与结构接缝保留可见。以黑和脏白为底，再把鲜艳热粉、黄、橘、青蓝与红色重点不均匀地撒开。均匀高位影棚光显出每块凸起部件，只留下轻微落地影。尽管内部信息密集，远看轮廓仍需清楚；长尖刺或杆可刺破上缘，较重部件压住下方。可迁移的效果强硬而有创造力，来自拾得材料肌理、极繁叠层、不对称细节与干净展示背景。
theme_en: A full-length masked figure in a dense assemblage of colorful found materials
theme_zh: 一名戴面罩的全身人物穿着密集彩色拾得材料组合装
name: Rammellzee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
